summary: Frontend-only regression completed against the public portfolio: build, live graphics, responsive overflow, navigation, theme, contact fallback, resume, and social links were verified.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailJS delivery remains UNCONFIGURED/MOCKED by design; the UI gives a graceful configuration message.
The new live graphics elements use class selectors rather than dedicated data-testid attributes, which limits automated targeting but did not block this regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL loaded with title 'Alok Kumawat · Java / Cloud / DevOps'. Responsive scrollWidth matched clientWidth at 320, 375, 768, 1024, and 1440px. Mobile menu, nav contact, theme toggle, contact fallback, resume URL/target, and LinkedIn/GitHub URLs passed. The final generic error scan was not executed because the test script had a JavaScript quoting syntax error; no app error was observed.
rca of the issue: No product defects reproduced. The only failure was in the test harness final page.evaluate expression due to nested single-quote escaping.
